edits.new:
Then no workflow, no Schedule and no file element is declared, and the document says why

  Scenario: AC7 The business rules BR1 to BR13 of section 8 each have a test or a boundary check (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules of section 8 and the document under test
    When each rule is compared with the operation, the element, the event or the table it governs
    Then each of BR1 to BR13 is checked by the test named in the coverage line of section 8, and a rule that is an architecture constraint is checked by a guardrail or boundary test instead
    Then a build that breaks one of BR1 to BR13 fails

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consent state set GIVEN and WITHDRAWN of AC2
    When a PUT on a contact point carries a consentState outside that set
    Then the write is refused with 422 under the one envelope, and its message ID is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P6-E4039-CON-AC8)
    Then the contact point stays at its stored state and no change is made
